liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_like@FY2025}}, taking cash liquidity to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}} of revenue, with undrawn committed facilities not part of that measure.
Debt due within one year was broadly unchanged at {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}}, so cash and cash-like investments cover the near-term maturities without new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2025}}, or {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2025}} of debt, down {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2025}}, as net capex rose by {{net_capex.change@FY2025}} to {{net_capex@FY2025}}.

Customer prepayments rose, with contract liabilities up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2025}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}} and advance ticket cover at {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}, up {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}}.

watch_items.text: Cash liquidity: cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_like@FY2025}}, leaving cash liquidity to revenue at {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, the weakest of the low-cost group ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2025}}).

Cash flow after leases: free cash flow after lease payments fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2025}}, only {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2025}} of debt, as net capex rose by {{net_capex.change@FY2025}}.
Leverage: net leverage rose by {{net_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{net_leverage@FY2025}} as net debt increased by {{net_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{net_debt@FY2025}}, in line with the peer median.

Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2025}}, with options exercised on additional 737 MAX 8 aircraft.
